Hi Katie,

Thanks again for the convo on Friday — great to hear Paxion is focused on a short pilot to validate inference quality and cost targets for your triage assistant. As promised, I attached a starter "engagement agreement" (we sometimes call it a MAP) and a collaborative evaluation worksheet so your team can edit acceptance criteria directly.

Attachments: [Attachment: engagement_agreement_template_v1.docx (12 KB)], [Attachment: evaluation_worksheet_collab.gdoc (Drive link below)]

Quick summary / asks:
- Please add/edit acceptance criteria in the worksheet (tab: "Tech & UX Criteria")
- Confirm pilot scope (30-day vs 60-day) and target success metrics by Wed 12/1
- If procurement needs a redline, let us know and Marissa will coordinate the CLA/contract path

Editable doc (view/comment until you tell us to lock): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcD-sample-link-eval-worksheet

Proposed 30-day cadence (if you want a quick starter):
1) Week 0: Kickoff & access — we provide a sandbox model and sample dataset
2) Week 1–2: Integration & smoke tests (low-latency threshold tests)
3) Week 3: Quality checks and prompt set evaluation (we'll run batch evals you can review)
4) Week 4: Final acceptance review and decision meeting

If a longer evaluation looks necessary we can extend milestones — I wanted to surface the minimal viable pilot so you can evaluate quickly.

Looping in Jasmine (Solutions Engineering) and Marissa (Customer Success) to help with the worksheet and contracting next steps.

Cheers,

- Week 2–4: Integration + live QA (continuous logging; Jasmine to run latency/cost baselines)
- Week 5–6: Acceptance evaluation and remediation (if metrics fall short)
